correctness.rationale: For the F3 Fermat quartic, the F9 Hermitian-surface structure gives 280 rational points and exactly 112 geometric generator lines, four through each crossing. F3 restriction is a split nondegenerate quadric with 16 points and 8 F3 generator lines; all others are 52 Frobenius pairs. Therefore normalization of the reduced 112-line divisor consists of 8 P1/F3 plus 52 P1/F9, and its 280 singular points are 16 fixed plus 132 pairs. Above fixed nodes 32 branches are fixed and the remaining branch orbits comprise 544 pairs; ordinary fourfold tangent directions yield arithmetic genus 1569 and H1 dimension 729. Exact sheaf normalization sequence gives H1 +1 multiplicity 369, -1 360; H2 weighted component classes are 60*(+3)+52*(-3). K3 Weil bound plus #S(F3)=16, #S(F9)=280 forces its H2 eigenvalues 12*(+3),10*(-3), and subtraction yields U=(Q-3)^2 odd degree and (Q-9)(Q-81) even degree; zeros exactly degrees 1,2,4. Independently reproduced genus, eigenspace trace, and first eight extension counts; the finite Hermitian enumeration source algorithm was inspected, not blindly accepted as infinite proof.
